_comment: The intended settings for the scheduled pipeline worker, in version control.
As with the other two: Railway reads config-as-code from the repository root,
so set RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH=backend/Dockerfile on the service instead.
different command and no health check: this service starts, does a day's
work and exits, so a health probe would report it down every time it
Set cronSchedule in the Railway UI rather than here, because two worker
services share this file and need different schedules:
09:30 UTC is after the local day has ended in every city in the registry,
including Pacific/Honolulu at UTC-10. See docs/deployment.md.
restartPolicyType NEVER is deliberate: a cron run that fails should wait for
tomorrow, not immediately retry against the same exhausted provider quota.
A failed run cannot corrupt the site — it never reaches the publish step, so
the last successful board stays up.
